# Dotfiles

![Desktop Screenshot](screenshots/screenshot-2026-06.png)

My personal dotfiles for a Linux desktop environment using [niri](https://github.com/YaLTeR/niri) and [noctalia](https://github.com/noctalia-dev/noctalia), managed with [stow](https://www.gnu.org/software/stow/).

Install dotfiles with stow:
```
stow */
```

To delete, run:

```
stow -D */
```
